name: Roster
consensus_round: resolve_challenge: binds ok, verdict and meets_criteria

verified_on_chain.entry_1_path: unchallenged, listed by finalise_entry after the window closed
verified_on_chain.exit_path: both entries delisted by the applicant, stakes returned

superseded_deployments.reason: a listed entry returned its deposit while settlement still assumed it was held
meets_criteria was coerced with bool(), so the string "false" would have become KEEP, and a failed round fell back to STRIKE

verdicts.KEEP: the entry meets the criteria, the challenger's bond goes to the applicant less the curation fee
verdicts.STRIKE: it does not, the applicant's deposit goes to the challenger less the curation fee
verdicts.UNRESOLVED: the round produced no usable finding, the bond goes back whole, the deposit stays staked, the entry returns to its prior status, no fee and no standing change

result_parser_rules: meets_criteria must be a JSON boolean literal, since bool("false") is True in Python
the boolean check precedes any numeric reading, since isinstance(True, int) is also True
a refusal is returned as data, never raised, because a raise inside the nondeterministic block cannot be caught by the deterministic frame
a failure of the consensus machinery resolves to UNRESOLVED rather than deciding the case against the applicant
